daily.today_energy: Your vibe is grounded but curious today. The cosmos is nudging you to trust your instincts more—that gut feeling you've been second-guessing? It's actually onto something real.
daily.love: Whether you're single or coupled up, today's about showing up authentically. Stop overthinking the small stuff and let people see the real you. Vulnerability hits different when it's genuine.
daily.career: Your attention to detail is a superpower right now. Channel that meticulous energy into one project that actually matters to you. Progress might be quiet, but it's building something solid.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance today—maybe less hustle, more flow. Movement that feels good (not punishing) will boost your mood. Hydrate and be gentle with yourself; you're doing better than you think.

weekly.love: Someone's noticing the real you underneath all that perfectionism. Whether you're coupled or single, this week invites vulnerability. Let people see the messy, beautiful parts. That's where real connection actually lives.
